newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale suspended till Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale suspended till Wednesday.

text.p: The auction of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) is delayed until Wednesday with the start time dependent on the courts, an aide to Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said.

The aide said the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) was expected to rule Wednesday on a government petition that a "conflict of interpretation" in lower courts meant a higher court should judge a series of injunctions against the sale.

"We hope they will rule in the morning so the auction can resume in the morning," the aide said. "Our life will become much easier once that ruling takes place because we won't have any more lower courts making decisions."
The National Development Bank (BNDES) said the CVRD auction was officially suspended until 1000 local/1300 GMT Wednesday.

The sale of 45 percent of voting shares of CVRD, the world's biggest iron ore exporter, had been due to start at 1000 local Tuesday but was suspended after a series of injunctions were issued by regional courts across the country.
The STJ earlier upheld one of those injunctions, one issued by a judge in Sao Paulo which government officials acknowledge to be the most troublesome.
